description.value:
You curse the target to be tormented by their own belongings. Inanimate objects defy the target's attempts to retrieve them, sprouting legs and scampering out of reach with a giggle. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, whenever the target Interacts to draw or pick up an item, it must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or the action is wasted. The target can spend an additional action when it Interacts to automatically succeed at this saving throw.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute. In addition, when the target fails the Reflex save, the item they were trying to draw or pick up falls to the ground in their space. The item then moves 5 feet in a random direction, and another 5 feet in a random direction at the start of each of the target's turns until retrieved.

Critical Failure As failure, but the effect lasts for 10 minutes.
